title: Which city or region will the DOSB choose in 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics?
background: The DOSB is Germany's national Olympic committee. Its domestic candidate selection is separate from the International Olympic Committee's eventual decision on which country will host the Games.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The DOSB's official selection announcement, as confirmed by reliable news reporting. 
  Resolution Conditions : Resolve to the city or region officially selected during 2026 to represent Germany in bidding for the 2036, 2040 or 2044 Summer Olympics. This concerns Germany's domestic candidate selection, not the eventual international host selection. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The name of the selected city or region.
